title: lobelia pubescens var. incisa
intro: Lobelia pubescens var. incisa, commonly known as the Alpine Lobelia, is a plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a nervine to calm the nervous system and as an antispasmodic to alleviate muscle spasms. Lobelia pubescens var. incisa contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
